claim: Space-JEPA improves leakage-controlled global anomaly detection over the strongest matched simple baseline on both frozen ESA-ADB lightweight mission surfaces.

comparison.per_seed_reference: max(EW_F_0.50(robust_zscore), EW_F_0.50(persistence)) on the same mission surface
comparison.overall_success: conjunction: both mission1-lite and mission2-lite must satisfy the surface success rule
comparison.missing_or_failed_seed_policy: fail_closed; do not drop, replace, or rerun a seed selectively
comparison.multiplicity_policy: no separate per-surface success claim: the primary paper claim is the conjunction across both frozen surfaces

secondary_only.repository_native_metrics: secondary and cannot rescue a failed primary endpoint

claim_boundaries: No outcome from official ESA held-out labels was used to choose this endpoint, seed rule, mission conjunction, or comparator family.
A primary failure cannot be rescued by anomaly-plus-rare-event, affiliation, channel-aware, repository-native, ablation, or astronomy results.
This endpoint supports comparison only against the two retained matched simple baselines; unexecuted official benchmark methods remain contextual rather than defeated baselines.
No causal diagnosis, root-cause attribution, closed-loop control, cross-mission generalization beyond the two named surfaces, or deployment claim follows from primary success.
All null, adverse, failed-seed, and comparator-favorable outcomes must be retained.

authorization.remaining_external_gate: retain and independently review exact official benchmark metadata/data byte identities and runtime receipts before outcome access
